_doc: W6b World 2 props. Frame units, 2 units = 1 world px. brazier_* and lantern_post_* are 64 x 96 (bottom centre (32, 96) on the floor); the rest are 64 x 64 tiles (drip_spout and waxfall_head hang from the tile top). flame = where the engine draws the live flame (brazier) or hangs the light (lantern, painted flame); drip = where drops form; pour = the waxfall column top centre, width its width in units.
